in_hindi.name: ज़लाय
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम उच्च और महान अर्थ रखता है

in_english.name: Zalay
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zalay is derived from the Arabic root 'ز-ل-ي' (z-l-y), which signifies elevation, rising, and sublimity. This name is used in Islamic tradition to denote someone of high moral character and elevated status. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root 'ز-ل-ي' conveys meanings related to rising and exaltation, reflecting a spiritual aspiration towards higher realms. Historically, names like Zalay have been chosen for their beautiful meanings and positive connotations, embodying virtues such as nobility and greatness.
